statements.statement: The patient presents with paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
There is concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is indicated
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The monitoring is to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation therapy
